understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through every level, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation matched each goal cell, then step onto each matching goal to activate it and advance. All goals in all levels had to be completed without losing all lives.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, and blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates only when all three carried-piece attributes match; stamina refills can restore stamina, while repeated blocked or poorly planned moves waste stamina.
